run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the number occurring an odd number of times in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify odd occurrence detection correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use XOR bitwise operation instead of a hash dictionary for O(1) space
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts element frequencies via a dict and returns the odd-count element
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty arrays or all even occurrences returning -1
